					limit = {
						1200 = {
							is_owned_by = NKO
							is_controlled_by = NKO
							radar_station < 6
							OR = {
								AND = {
									NKO = { has_tech = radar }
									check_variable = { building_level@radar_station < 6 }
								}
							}
						}
					}
					1200 = {
						add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
						add_building_construction = { type = radar_station level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
				else = {
					601 = {
						add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
						add_building_construction = { type = radar_station level = 1 instant_build = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = { COLDWAR_NKO_complete_air_warning_network = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}
